title: 8x8 Continuous Patch-Shift Latent Interpolation
intuition: Learns 16 zero-sigma particles on continuously translated 2x2 unit-peak patches across an 8x8 image canvas and probes unseen latent k-NN midpoints. True manifold interpolation translates a single sharp peak (interp_peak >= 0.78).
failure_mode: Pixel-space linear blending / double-exposure ghosting produces two half-height (~0.50) patches at latent midpoints instead of one shifted unit-height patch (a verified open failure on `unified-v11`/`v12`).
protocol_notes: Tier-2 stretch task using 16 zero-sigma particles and residual-upsample image generator.
